# exports

[Project overview](../README.md)

Generated drawings, manufacturing review files, printable parts and validation reports.

**A0 engineering prototype.** CAD checks do not establish physical fit, electrical protection or production readiness.

Print only the selected base/lid pair plus the universal clamp; test coupons first. STL/3MF are in print orientation; STEP is in assembly coordinates. Each PCB variant has its own fabrication and assembly population files.
